did.description: The member asserting personhood; MUST equal the presentation's holder.

presentation.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation (opaque here). Its holder MUST match did, its proof.challenge MUST be the paired challengeId, and it MUST carry at least one credential satisfying the community's active personhood policy. A Verifiable Witness Credential in it counts only with paired outcomeEvidence.

outcomeEvidence.description: OPTIONAL. The outcome evidence of the witnessing sessions that the Verifiable Witness Credentials in presentation cite: one entry per VWC the member wants counted, each the witness/session document the VWC's taskContext names and the witness/session/submit #response that delivered it, exactly as stored, never re-serialised. A VWC with no paired entry counts for nothing; an entry pairing with no VWC in presentation is ignored.

personhood.description: Always true on success — the flag flipped or stayed asserted.

vmc.description: Re-issued membership credential carrying the asserted personhood (opaque here).

roleVac.description: Re-issued role credential (opaque here): a Verifiable Authority Credential (`type` including `AuthorityCredential`) issued by the community with `issuerScope` `public`, whose `credentialSubject.authority` is `{ scope: <community DID>, actions: ["role:<name>"] }` — the shape vtc/vetting/vetters/grant/0.1 issues.
